nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Provides the repository's top-level build automation for local or Docker development, production startup, formatting, checks, hooks, and commit readiness.
nodes.languageNotes: Phony Make targets delegate environment-specific startup to subordinate makefiles and centralize Python and frontend quality commands.

nodes.name: local-dev
nodes.summary: Delegates local development startup to the dedicated local makefile.

nodes.name: docker-dev
nodes.summary: Delegates containerized development startup to the Docker makefile.

nodes.name: prod-dev
nodes.summary: Delegates production-like development startup to the deployment makefile.

nodes.name: fix
nodes.summary: Applies Ruff formatting and lint fixes to Python code and Biome fixes to the frontend.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Runs Python lint and format checks plus frontend Biome and TypeScript validation.

nodes.name: install-hooks
nodes.summary: Installs the repository's pre-commit hooks into the local Git checkout.

nodes.name: commit-ready
nodes.summary: Combines automatic fixes and validation checks into the pre-commit readiness target.
